Short corrective static/mock ACP batch. PR #54, PR #56 and unrelated PR #58 are NOT accepted. Start ONLY from the exact unchanged target head/tree above. Keep this task narrow: implement `src/relay/acp_client.py` as a RelayTransport-compatible deterministic test-double transport and tests only. Do not change RelayLifecycle/RelayTransport/provider policy/Core/workflows. No subprocess/network/provider/auth/billing/settings/live execution.

Required API must match RelayTransport exactly: initialize(provider_id)->dict, open_session(provider_id,cwd=...)->str, prompt(provider_id,session_id,payload,timeout_seconds=None)->bytes, cancel(provider_id,session_id), close(provider_id,session_id).

Determinism: do NOT use uuid/random/time. Session IDs must be deterministic monotonic values scoped to the client, e.g. `acp-mock:<provider_id>:1`, `:2`.

Initialize: injected fixture/config only; require protocol_version==1, account auth accepted via the existing ProviderPolicy passed to ACPClient, capabilities must be a dict and every advertised capability entry other than auth metadata must have the documented local-mock object/dict shape. Missing/unknown/unsupported values fail closed. Return live_process_started=False.

Prompt: exactly one prompt per open session. Support local flags/fields for deterministic timeout and generic error simulation used by tests. If timeout flag is set, raise TimeoutError; if error flag is set, raise RuntimeError. Otherwise a terminal response MUST be explicitly configured for that session/provider and MUST be bytes. Missing terminal response, None, str, int, list or dict must raise; NEVER return b'' as a default; NEVER stringify/coerce malformed terminal values. Return configured bytes EXACTLY unchanged.

Update evidence: capture configured ordered update events into a separate per-session evidence snapshot using deepcopy before interpretation. Do NOT inject/wrap/mutate terminal bytes. Reject malformed update entries that are not dicts before returning success. Provide a read-only/copying accessor for tests if useful.

Safety callbacks: explicit methods for permission, file read, file write, terminal request, elicitation/user-input, and unknown extension/notification. Each must record a deepcopy and return False/denied; never auto-approve.

Lifecycle-state invariants inside ACPClient: prompt only on open session, no second prompt, cancel only once, close only once; prompt after cancel or close must fail. Keep provider/session binding and reject wrong-provider operations.

Tests must cover all of the above directly, including deterministic session IDs, exact raw terminal bytes, missing/malformed terminal fail-closed, timeout/error raising, evidence separation and deepcopy, malformed update rejection, each safety callback separately, wrong provider, second prompt/cancel/close, prompt after cancel/close, and live_process_started=False. Also add a tiny integration test using existing RelayLifecycle without modifying it to prove: timeout/error after session creation => exactly one cancel + exactly one close; stop-before-dispatch => no session; duplicate same envelope => no second prompt. Use only local doubles.

Update checkpoint with static/mock-only wording and independent Chat validation required. Run focused tests, then once: `PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -v`, `python -m compileall -q src tests`, `git diff --check`. Normal Jules PR only. No merge/force push.
